Gained hands-on experience in MERN stack development using MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js by building sample web

PROJECTS 
Car Rental System 2026 
Developed a MERN-based Car Rental Management System that enables users to browse, book, and manage vehicle rentals through an 
intuitive web interface. Implemented secure authentication, vehicle management, booking workflows, and responsive dashboards to 
enhance user experience and streamline rental operations. 
Tech Stack: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Python, Tailwind CSS. 
Public Health Chatbot for Disease Awareness 2026 
Engineered a healthcare management platform integrating an AI-powered disease awareness chatbot, doctor consultation, and 
appointment scheduling. Implemented patient and doctor dashboards, booking approval systems, and secure MongoDB-based data 
management for efficient healthcare services. 
Technologies: Python, Flask, MongoDB, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, AI Chatbot Integration 
On-Duty Tracker – Student OD Management System 2025 
Designed and developed On-Duty Tracker, a web-based platform for streamlining student On-Duty request submissions, faculty 
approvals, and record management. Implemented role-based access, secure data storage, and real-time status tracking to improve 
administrative efficiency. 
Tools Used: Python, Flask, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, MongoDB
